name: Midou Izuna
source: She is a pureblooded ningyo that has lived for hundreds of years. She has a nasty hobby of giving birth and eating her own children when they grow up.[spoiler]She is actually the mother of Yuu, Ruri and the protagonist. [/spoiler]
